اضطلعت (form VIII)
# اِضْطَلَعْتُ (iḍṭalaʕtu) /idˤ.tˤa.laʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# اِضْطَلَعْتَ (iḍṭalaʕta) /idˤ.tˤa.laʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# اِضْطَلَعْتِ (iḍṭalaʕti) /idˤ.tˤa.laʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# اِضْطَلَعَتْ (iḍṭalaʕat) /idˤ.tˤa.la.ʕat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
